name: Plagiarism Checker X
author: plagiarismcheckerx

sections.description:
Open the Plagiarism Checker X sidebar in the block editor and run the check you need:

  • Plagiarism – finds passages that match pages on the web, with a link to each source.
  • AI Detection – shows which passages read as AI-written.
  • Grammar – spelling and grammar issues with suggested fixes.
  • Readability – a reading-ease score and grade level, with long and hard-to-read sentences marked.

Using the classic editor? The Plagiarism Checker X box beside the editor runs the same four checks on the text in the editor and shows each score, with a link to the full report.

The Posts and Pages lists get a Plagiarism Checker X column with each post’s scores. A post that has not been checked shows a Scan button: click it to check the saved post without opening it.

Findings are highlighted in the post while the check is open. Clicking a finding scrolls to it; clicking a highlighted passage shows its finding. Highlights are painted by the browser and are never saved into your post.

A check runs only when you click Run. Plagiarism and AI Detection spend the words of your Plagiarism Checker X plan, and a re-scan after edits spends only the edited words. Grammar and Readability are free.

External services

This plugin connects to the Plagiarism Checker X API (https://api.plagiarismcheckerx.com) to check your text. Nothing is sent until an administrator connects the site, and then only when a writer clicks Run, Re-scan or Scan.

  • When an administrator connects the site, the site’s name and its WordPress admin address are sent so Plagiarism Checker X can register the site and send the administrator back after they approve.
  • When a writer runs a check, the post’s text, its title and the site’s host name are sent to Plagiarism Checker X, which checks the text and stores the result in the account that connected the site.
  • The settings page and the sidebar ask Plagiarism Checker X for the account’s plan and words left.

Plagiarism Checker X terms of service: https://plagiarismcheckerx.com/terms-conditions – privacy policy: https://plagiarismcheckerx.com/privacy-policy

Source code

The editor sidebar’s readable source is in the src/ folder of this plugin. build/ is made from it with @wordpress/scripts (wp-scripts build src/index.js).
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Plagiarism Checker X and click Connect to Plagiarism Checker X (or paste an API key).
  3. Open a post or page and click the Plagiarism Checker X icon in the editor toolbar (in the classic editor, use the Plagiarism Checker X box), or click Scan in the Posts or Pages list.
sections.faq:
Does it change my post?

No. Highlights are drawn over the editor by the browser and are never part of the post’s content.

Which editor does it support?

Both. The block editor gets the full sidebar with highlights (WordPress 6.3 and later); the classic editor gets a box with each check’s score and a link to the full report. Posts and pages are supported; a developer can add other post types with the plagchx_post_types filter.
sections.changelog:
0.2.1

  • Classic editor box: each check on one line (name, result, Re-scan), results in one colour, no words-left card.

0.2.0

  • Pages as well as posts.
  • Classic editor support: a Plagiarism Checker X box with all four checks.
  • A Plagiarism Checker X column in the Posts and Pages lists, with a Scan button for posts not yet checked.

0.1.0

  • First version: Plagiarism, AI Detection, Grammar and Readability checks in the editor sidebar.

screenshots.caption: Plagiarism: matching passages are marked in the post, each with the page it matches.
AI Detection: how much of the post reads as AI-written or mixed, with those passages marked.
Grammar: each issue is underlined in the post, with a suggested fix.
Readability: a reading-ease score, level and grade, with hard-to-read passages marked and advice on each.
The Plagiarism Checker X sidebar: four checks and the words left on your plan.
Settings: connect the site, then see your plan and words left.
